text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... pant... I let it all... out on... the track...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How'd... Brusquement do?

text_block_list.name: Brusquement
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's in rough shape... I
didn't think
a prodigy racer like her
would ever get tired...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I guess she has her limits, too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rush over to her with a towel and
supplements,
when...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I feel like I was really able to
run as
myself on the track today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Brusquement was just as incredible as
always, but
her performance was even
sharper and more
refined than last year.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could run like that.
But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She can't run my way either. Brute forcing through things and going all out isn't her style...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's mine. I'm the only one who can run
like that...
We both have our own unique
running styles...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wow... There are so many happy fans...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After half a year, they were finally able
to see
each other for who they really are
and bring
closure to their classic-year
rivalry.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita... How was she able to squeeze so
much
power into her running?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Could I do the same? Do I know my
strengths?
Am I holding on to things that
need to go?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose... I really don't...
want to be
left behind...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This fall, I swear I'll win a G1 race. I will
rise no
matter what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, after the awards ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It seems Brusquement injured her leg
during the
race. We won't know to what
extent until the test
results come back,
however.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? She got hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but she's incredibly pleased she was
able to
run against you. You gave her a
very fulfilling
race, Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As one who was raised under my
mother's
tutelage, she was able to learn
more about herself
on a deeper level
today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What she's learned today will live on,
not only for
her sake but for those who
come after her as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That said, with her leg in its current
state, she
won't be able to start
sprinting at full force right
away.
Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This fall, race in her stead, Kitasan
Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me? Run for Brusquement too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though the legacies in your blood
are
different, your passion for racing is
one and the
same...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And the only one she can entrust that
passion
to... is you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Got it! I'll run for her, Air Groove! I
promise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gives a slight nod before
taking her
leave.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the autumn Tenno Sho,
Trainer. After
that will be three
back-to-back G1 races...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My opponents are only going to get
stronger
from here, and my endurance is
going to be
pushed to its limit, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Man, my chest feels so hot! It's
like I got a
huge boost of power today!
choice_data_list: 頑張らなくちゃな、ブリュスクマンの分も
頑張らなくちゃね、ブリュスクマンの分も
choice_data_list_en: Gotta give it my all, for Brusqueman's sake too.
We have to give it our all, for Brusqueman's sake too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the baton entrusted to her and a
new fire in
her eyes, Kitasan Black has
reached yet another
new level in her
growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the curtain falls on the three

consecutive spring G1 races.
